# Staples

> Staples is a leading office supply retailer offering business essentials, packaging supplies, furniture, printing services, and the Easy Rewards loyalty program.

Staples serves businesses and consumers with a comprehensive catalog of office products, shipping materials, technology accessories, and workplace solutions. The site features specialized services including AutoRestock for automated replenishment, Staples Travel Hub with TSA PreCheck enrollment, and custom printing services for business needs.

## Key Topics

- Staples Easy Rewards
- Office Supplies
- Packaging & Shipping Supplies
- Corrugated Boxes (ECT-32, C-flute)
- Poly Bags (FDA/USDA approved)
- Printing Services
- AutoRestock
- Staples Travel Hub & TSA PreCheck
- Printer Supplies (Epson, ribbons)
- Partners Brand & SI Products
- EPA CPG Compliance
- Business Essentials
- Eco-ID Sustainable Products
- Storage & Organization
- Technology Accessories
